# Zion Inn Homestay (Zion Inn Rooms)

> Ministry of Tourism approved family homestay in Neyyoor, Kanyakumari District, Tamil Nadu, India. Handcrafted AC and Non-AC king rooms starting at ₹1,000/night (2 kids stay free), 750 m from Eraniel Railway Station and 6.9 km from Padmanabhapuram Palace.

Zion Inn Homestay is a government-accredited, family-operated lodging in southern Tamil Nadu. The property provides quiet accommodations with private garden verandas, en-suite bathrooms, uninterrupted 24/7 power backup, high-speed dual-band fiber Wi-Fi, and a secure gated compound for guest parking.

Room tariffs are ₹1,200 INR per night for the AC King Suite and ₹1,000 INR per night for the Non-AC King Room. Standard check-in is 14:00 IST and check-out is 11:00 IST. The homestay is located 750 m (2 mins) from Eraniel Railway Station (ERL), 18 km from Nagercoil Junction (NCJ), 32 km from Kanyakumari Cape, and 58 km from Trivandrum International Airport (TRV).
